name: hol-guard
tagline_zh: 本地 AI 插件乱装怕中毒？一条命令扫描 MCP/Skill 的安全与合规，还能自动修复。别处没有的：直接跑 uv。
tagline_en: Scan MCP/skills for security & compliance, auto-fix issues—all via one uv command. No setup, just guard.
desc_en: Run HOL Guard scanner and guard operations via `uv run hol-guard`. Use when the user asks to scan plugins/MCP/skills for security, quality, or ecosystem compliance, or when they ask to run guard detect/install/protect workflows for local AI harnesses.
why_zh: 同类要装半天依赖，它用 uv 秒跑；不只报错，还能直接 install/protect 修复。
why_en: Unlike scanners that just report, hol-guard fixes via uv—zero setup, instant detect-to-protect workflow.
